# BREAKING: GIE Announces Alliance With International Comintern, Invites TIC to Join

The Greater Israeli Empire (GIE) has announced an alliance with the International Comintern, GIE leader RICHARDBROADHURST confirmed to BCBN.

The GIE has also publicly invited The Inner Circle (TIC) to a formal military alliance. The two factions currently have a non-aggression pact, signed last week. 

The announcements follow a battle in which, according to the GIE, it was attacked by an unknown player, later joined by a second. The GIE says forces from the International Comintern and four TIC members joined to support it. The GIE said it is working to identify the attacker and has promised that they will face consequences if they belong to a faction.

More information will follow.

# BREAKING: Eastern Meridian Pact Collapses

The Eastern Meridian Pact (EMP) has collapsed after four members of its Board of Directives left to form a new faction, according to EMP President @prosperitybacon .

JustCheese said he and the Vice President are stepping back from leadership for the time being, and that the EMP's Discord server has been deleted. He added that the EMP plans to return under a new name during the Christmas break.

In a message to members, JustCheese thanked everyone who served under his leadership and wished those who left good luck in their new faction.

More information will follow.
